description: Unverified observations from OCD Check reports (observed/reports/), per device, carrier profile, software stack and release entry. A report only points at an entry of an OCD data release; it never changes an OCD value, a file under generated/ or a release, and it never makes a phone skip its own test. Nothing here is a support claim.

statuses.reported: Counted reports of people's phones, by result. Not checked by OCD: anyone can open an issue, and nothing checks who sent a report or whether the phone exists.
statuses.contested: At least one counted report measured a clean failure of the entry (the test ran and the phone's state came back). It asks the next phone to test the entry and a maintainer to look; it switches nothing off.
statuses.retested_by_ocd: Set only from OCD's own phones after a passed T2 call test, from the owner's private ledger. Empty until that status is published.
